title: Identification of novel natural product inhibitors of BRD4 using high throughput virtual screening and MD simulation.
authors: Barman, Soumen; Sahoo, Snehasudha Subhadarsini; Padhan, Jyotirmayee; Sudhamalla, Babu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和MD模拟寻找BRD4溴结构域的小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bromodomains are evolutionarily conserved structural motifs that recognize acetylated lysine residues on histone tails. They play a crucial role in shaping chromatin architecture and regulating gene expression in various biological processes. Mutations in bromodomains containing proteins lead to multiple human diseases, which makes them attractive target for therapeutic intervention. Extensive studies have been done on BRD4 as a target for several cancers, such as Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) and Burkitt Lymphoma. Several potential inhibitors have been identified against the BRD4 bromodomain. However, most of these inhibitors have drawbacks such as non-specificity and toxicity, decreasing their appeal and necessitating the search for novel non-toxic inhibitors. This study aims to address this need by virtually screening natural compounds from the NPASS database against the Kac binding site of BRD4-BD1 using high throughput molecular docking followed by similarity clustering, pharmacokinetic screening, MD simulation and MM-PBSA binding free energy calculations. Using this approach, we identified five natural product inhibitors having a similar or better binding affinity to the BRD4 bromodomain compared to JQ1 (previously reported inhibitor of BRD4). Further systematic analysis of these inhibitors resulted in the top three hits: NPC268484 (Palodesangren-B), NPC295021 (Candidine) and NPC313112 (Buxifoliadine-D). Collectively, our in silico results identified some promising natural products that have the potential to act as potent BRD4-BD1 inhibitors and can be considered for further validation through future in vitro and in vivo studies.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域（bromodomains）是进化上保守的结构基序，能够识别组蛋白尾部乙酰化的赖氨酸残基。它们在塑造染色质结构和调控多种生物过程中的基因表达方面发挥着关键作用。含有溴结构域的蛋白质发生突变会导致多种人类疾病，这使它们成为治疗干预的吸引性靶点。针对BRD4作为多种癌症（如急性髓系白血病（AML）和伯基特淋巴瘤）的靶点，已有大量研究。已鉴定出多种针对BRD4溴结构域的潜在抑制剂。然而，这些抑制剂大多存在非特异性和毒性等缺点，降低了其吸引力，因此有必要寻找新型无毒抑制剂。本研究旨在通过高通量分子对接，结合相似性聚类、药代动力学筛选、分子动力学（MD）模拟和MM-PBSA结合自由能计算，对NPASS数据库中的天然化合物进行虚拟筛选，针对BRD4-BD1的Kac结合位点。通过这种方法，我们鉴定出五种天然产物抑制剂，其与BRD4溴结构域的结合亲和力与JQ1（先前报道的BRD4抑制剂）相似或更优。对这些抑制剂进一步系统分析后，得到三个最佳候选：NPC268484（Palodesangren-B）、NPC295021（Candidine）和NPC313112（Buxifoliadine-D）。总体而言，我们的计算机模拟结果鉴定出一些有前景的天然产物，它们有潜力作为强效的BRD4-BD1抑制剂，并可考虑通过未来的体外和体内研究进行进一步验证。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
